from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaperReference(BaseModel):
    """One paper referenced from the provided collection within a given document's bibliography."""
    referenced_paper_title: str = Field(description="The full title of the referenced paper as it appears in the bibliography")
    reference_number: str | None = Field(description="The reference number/citation marker from this document's bibliography, if present")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and which OTHER provided papers it references from the collection."""
    paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of this document/paper")
    references_provided_collection: list[ProvidedPaperReference] = Field(description="Bibliographic entries referring to OTHER provided papers in this collection")
    known_reference_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from document summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list - for citation graph construction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
